body: For most languages of the world, language model pre-training operates in a data-constrained regime where models must repeat their training data many times, degrading generalization. Two remedies exist: aggressive hyperparameter tuning such as high weight decay, and mixing in data from a high-resource auxiliary language to directly aid the low-resource target. While hyperparameter tuning regularizes the model by shrinking weights to restrict network capacity, auxiliary data mixing uses a tunable mixing ratio to expand the training distribution and diversify the training signal with new…
summaryZh: Apple机器学习团队针对全球大多数语言面临的数据受限预训练困境展开研究，对比了激进超参数调整与引入高资源辅助语言数据混合这两种主要策略。研究表明，通过精心调配混合比例，扩展训练分布并引入新信号，比单纯通过限制网络容量来规范模型的做法更能提升模型的泛化能力。
